name: Nashboard B2B API
description:
The Nashboard B2B API provides merchant enrichment, receipt OCR, and self-service account management for fintech developers. Base URL: https://api.nashboard.ai. Interactive docs: https://api.nashboard.ai/docs.

## Data sources & attribution

The merchant reference corpus is built exclusively from openly licensed data:

- **Overture Maps Places** — © Overture Maps Foundation and its data contributors. Licensed under CDLA Permissive 2.0 (only the CDLA-Permissive-2.0 subset is ingested).
- **Foursquare Open Source Places (FSQ OS Places)** — © Foursquare. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).
- **Wikidata** — released under CC0 1.0.
- **AllThePlaces** and **GLEIF LEI** — released under CC0 1.0.

No OpenStreetMap/ODbL or other share-alike data is included in API responses — share-alike rows are filtered out at the source-license layer, so API output is redistributable.
